description: The natural-number predecessor map is surjective but not injective: it sends both 0 and 1 to 0 and sends n + 1 to n.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiniteAndCountableSets.predecessor_example :
  Function.Surjective Nat.pred ∧
    ¬Function.Injective Nat.pred ∧ Nat.pred 0 = 0 ∧ Nat.pred 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), (n + 1).pred = n
